name: SIDE STEP JACKS
introduce:
Stand upright with your feet together and arms by your sides. 

Step one foot out to the side, raise your arms up and bring your hands overhead.

Return, switch sides and repeat the exercise.

tips.text: Bend your arms to bring your hands over your head.
Your arms shouldn\'t be straight when you raise them above your head.
Please adjust your cadence according to your preferences.
